event: Nala turns on the burned, whimpering demon and bites into its darkness.
prose: It held you in its teeth the whole way up from the Ocean, toying with you. Now it can barely hold its own shape. You turn on it and bite down into its darkness, the way it bit into you.

event: The demon flinches and tries to curl away, too weak to hold its own shape.
prose: It flinches. It tries to curl away from you, but it has nothing left to curl with, and its edges sag and run like smoke.

event: She tears at it the way it tore at her, and it comes apart in ragged shreds.
prose: You tear at it the way it tore at you, slowly, and then not slowly at all. It comes away in ragged shreds.

event: A claw rakes her once, feebly; she bites through the claw.
prose: One claw scrapes across you, weak as a kitten's. You bite through it.

event: No snicker now; it only shrieks, thin and fading.
prose: The voice that snickered in your head is gone. It shrieks instead, thin and high, and each shriek is fainter than the last.

event: She swallows shred after shred, cold and bitter, until nothing of it is left.
The demon is gone; the place beside her is empty.
She spreads into the half of the body it held; the whole small body is hers now.
Something cold settles in her: dark threads of the demon, woven through her soul.
The heartbeat goes on, steady and slow; nothing outside has noticed.
A voice not her own sounds in her soul: "Status withheld. Mind too young to choose."
"If you understand, kick twice." Then silence, waiting on her.
